notes: T2 Jailbreak on HQ jacked out after passing the outer ice, so the event did nothing; T3-T4 seven credit clicks to 13c while Daily Casts and breakers sat in grip. T5 facechecked the Jinteki remote with no breakers (Saisentan milled Swift, Mu Safecracker, Daily Casts), then jacked out after passing the only ice instead of accessing the advanced card. T8 reinstalled a second Docklands Pass (unique, trashed) and left the 2-advanced Server 3 alone. T9 ran a fresh remote (Urtica Cipher, already seen in HQ T6) first and then ran Server 3 with 1 card in grip, so the Fujii Asset Retrieval steal flatlined it; a foreseeable loss.

Won, but Cat's Cradle (T2) was never used on Vertigo: about ten R&D runs went through unbroken Vertigo, losing clicks and sometimes the ability to steal (T2, T4, T6, T8). Carmen fetched with Mutual Favor and installed for 5c on T4 was never used before Ansel 1.0 trashed it on T5, after the Runner went into the unrezzed ice with 0c left. Remote pressure with Marjanah (T4, T8, T10) and the Archives check on T10 were good.

Early HQ pressure stole two Above the Law, but the Runner stayed at 0-2c for the whole game and never played the Sure Gamble it held until Measured Response trashed it. Repeated R&D runs in one turn could only see the same top card (T5, T7, T11). On T10 it ran HQ through Hammer four times at 0c, taking 4 tags against a Weyland deck after seeing Retribution in HQ repeatedly, then never cleared tags. Retribution (T11) and a 4-meat Measured Response (T12) flatlined it at 3 cards, which was foreseeable.

Solid economy (Sure Gamble, three Daily Casts, No Free Lunch) and steady R&D pressure that found Project Ingatan (T3) and Méliès (T8). Red Team (T7, 5c) was never used. HQ was ignored from T2 to T9 although the Corp was discarding from a full hand, and the win came from HQ via Docklands Pass and Marjanah on T9; it should have been run earlier.

Spent T1 on Tremolo and Revolver, then went broke. On T3 it facechecked R&D in a Jinteki matchup with 2c and 3 cards and lost Diesel, Red Team and Jailbreak to Anemone. Correctly avoided the 3-advanced Server 2 (likely the Urtica Cipher seen T2), and Tremolo beat Hafrún for Hybrid Release (T5). Archives held facedown cards from T3 (Anemone and Hansei discards) but went unchecked until T7, when it held two Fujii Asset Retrieval for the win.

T1 Pinhole Threading was played with no remote in play, so it had no target. T2-T4 made 11 R&D runs, several in a row on an unchanged top card. From T6 to T14 it ran R&D through known Ansel 1.0 with no breaker about 15 times: Ansel trashed Marjanah, gave the Corp free installs and prevented steals, so those runs could never score. It paid 2c every turn to trash the Nico or Otto that Ansel kept reinstalling. It held 3 cards and never drew or played them from T5 to T15, and won only on a late Megaprix.

Installed Buzzsaw T1, then ran HQ into the same Afshar nine times without breaking it (T1-T10), losing 2c each time, which kept it at 3-5c. Fencer Fueno (T8) only banked credits. From T10 to T12 it sat on 10-15c clicking for credits and drawing into a full hand that had to discard (T11, T12). It never ran Server 1 while the Corp advanced Transport Monopoly (T8-T9), SDS (T10-T11) and Above the Law (T12-T13).

Never installed a single card all game: it clicked for credits from T1 to T15, ending with 54c and an untouched 5-card grip. Its only activity was trashing naked assets (Wall to Wall, ZATO, Luana Campos T4-T5) and facechecking Tree Line (T6) and Akhet (T9) with no breakers. SDS, two Divested Trust and Above the Law were all scored uncontested from Servers 4 and 6.

T2 ran R&D four times, three of them on the same top card. On T4 Burner revealed Embedded Reporting, Hedge Fund and Next Big Thing; it stacked Hedge Fund on top of Embedded Reporting, then ran R&D three times seeing only Hedge Fund. The Corp drew Embedded Reporting and later scored it for the win. From T5 on it never installed a breaker and clicked for credits to 38c, ran Server 7 once into Ping (T10), and let Next Big Thing (T12) and Embedded Reporting (T13) score.

Won, but it ran HQ into known Unsmiling Tsarevna unbroken on T4, T10, T11 and T12, taking 2 net damage and a tag each time. That lost uninstalled breakers and economy (Echelon twice, Pantograph, Unity, Mantle, Stoneship, Rigging Up) that it should have installed. It spent T2 Spec Work trashing its own Gauss, reinstalled Telework Contract while tagged (T3), and spent about 12c on tag removal. On T10 Burner again put Virtual Service Agent on top of Next Big Thing, then ran R&D through Grubber for 6c to see Virtual Service Agent.

Good T5 Rigging Up into Gauss to steal Embedded Reporting. It kept running R&D through Virtual Service Agent unbroken (T6-T16) and stayed tagged, so Daily Casts was trashed over and over while it kept reinstalling it (T8, T9). On T6 it ran HQ and R&D instead of the freshly installed Server 1 card, which the Corp scored T7. Spec Work trashed Unity one turn after Rigging Up installed it (T14) and then Echelon (T15); Echelon and Self-modifying Code never broke anything.

It ran HQ into the same Afshar about 20 times (T1-T24), never breaking it and losing 2c each time. Yet on T7 and in Server 1, Buzzsaw broke Afshar for 1c. It was stuck at 0-3c for 20 turns, never played Sure Gamble, and Gachapon (T17) installed a second unique Fencer Fueno instead of Trickster Taka. It won only because the passive Corp discarded Transport Monopoly twice and SDS into Archives.

Installed Unity T1, then clicked for credits from T4 to T11 (to 26c) holding a full grip and installing nothing. It let Tomorrow's Headline (Server 4, installed T6), Embedded Reporting (installed T8) and Next Big Thing (installed T10, advanced over three turns) all score. On T12, with 26c, it ran Server 1 to trash Vladisibirsk City Grid instead of the 2-advanced Next Big Thing in Server 4.

Strong aggressive game: Carpe Diem stole Regenesis T1, R&D found Fujii Asset Retrieval T2 after trashing Mavirus, and Transfer of Wealth drained the Corp. Shibboleth and Docklands Pass then hammered HQ to win T6. The only waste was repeated R&D runs on an unchanged top card on T1.

Good tempo: Docklands Pass plus Shibboleth on HQ stole Regenesis, Longevity Serum and Hybrid Release by T3, and later Longevity Serum and Yagi-Uda. Revolver (T2) and Pennyshaver (T5) were installed but never paid off. The T6 run on a fresh Jinteki remote cost two cards to Urtica Cipher but was survivable.

On T2 it reinstalled Cat's Cradle and ran straight back into the Ansel 1.0 that had just trashed it. It then made about 30 R&D runs through Ansel unbroken (T2-T13), each one barred from stealing and giving the Corp a free install. On T11 it accessed Méliès City Luxury Line in the open Server 2 four times with clicks left and declined the click to steal every time; the Corp scored it T12. On T13 it reached it again on its last click, and a second Méliès won the game T15.

Slow start that facechecked Akhet (T3) and Tree Line (T4) without fitting breakers, and ran Archives nearly every turn while the Corp built Server 1. It stole Divested Trust (T13) and SDS (T14) well. Then, sitting on 15-19c, it ignored the advancing remotes: T20 Stargate on R&D (Tree Line, no breaker) instead of Server 1 or 2, and T22 Archives plus credit clicks while Server 2 held the winning Transport Monopoly. Gachapon fetched Mystic Maemi only to install a duplicate that was trashed (T20).

On T3 it accessed Méliès City Luxury Line in HQ on its first click and declined the click cost to steal. On T6, T7 and T8 it ran the unprotected Server 3 four times per turn, accessed the same Méliès 12 times, and never paid the click; the Corp scored it T9. After Ansel 1.0 trashed Carmen and Marjanah (T4) it ran R&D through Vertigo and Ansel unbroken about 20 times, unable to steal. On T19 it ignored the naked Server 13, where Seamless Launch scored the winning Superconducting Hub.

T1 facecheck of HQ lost Cat's Cradle to Ansel 1.0, but the Server 1 steal was good. T5 Mutual Favor fetched a second Carmen while one was installed, and it was never played. It paid 5c to Carmen through Ansel on HQ on T9, T10 and T13, repeatedly seeing Ansel and Hedge Fund. On T13 Pinhole Threading accessed a Nico Campaign in Server 4 instead of the freshly installed card in Server 2, which was the Project Ingatan the Corp scored T14 to win.

T1 ran an unprotected R&D four times, three of them on the same top card. After Strike Fund and Sure Gamble (T2) it installed nothing for the rest of the game and clicked for credits to 36c (T4-T9). It ran Akhet (T3) and Afshar (T9) with no breakers and let Divested Trust, Above the Law, SDS and another Divested Trust score from one remote.
